structure.unit: Taxes Administered by the Department of Taxation

law.catch_line: (Contingent expiration dates) Distribution of recordation tax to the Commonwealth Transportation Fund
law.text: Of the state recordation taxes imposed pursuant to §§ 58.1-801 and 58.1-803, the revenues collected each fiscal year from $0.03 of the total tax imposed under each section shall be deposited by the Comptroller into the Commonwealth Transportation Fund established pursuant to § 33.2-1524.
